description: A newline may appear between any two tokens of a tuple for expression
notes: The Collection Values section says newlines are ignored between the delimiters of "these sequences", which refers to the tuple and object productions. ForExpr is a separate production whose grammar has no Newline, and the spec repeats the newline rule for parentheses, function call arguments and index brackets but never for for expressions. hashicorp/hcl ignores newlines everywhere inside a for expression: finishParsingForExpr in hclsyntax/parser.go calls PushIncludeNewlines(false). Before that, parseTupleCons turns newlines off to look for the for keyword after the bracket.
